title: Algeria terrestrial water storage anomaly (downscaled GRACE/GRACE-FO): national and wilaya, 2002–2025
title_fr: Anomalie du stock d'eau terrestre de l'Algérie (GRACE/GRACE-FO désagrégé) : nation et wilayas, 2002–2025
description: Monthly change in total water stored on and below the land surface, in cm of water relative to 2004–2009, averaged by AEO over Algeria and its 69 wilayas from the 0.25° downscaled GRACE/GRACE-FO dataset of Li & Kusche (2026), 2002-04 to 2025-03, with uncertainty and Theil–Sen trends.
purpose: Show long-term gains and losses of water storage, including the decline of Algeria's large aquifer systems, at the scales GRACE can support.

provider.name: Li & Kusche (University of Bonn), from NASA JPL mascons; Algeria Earth Observatory (regional statistics)

creator: Algeria Earth Observatory maintainers (regional statistics); F. Li and J. Kusche (downscaled dataset)
license_notes: The downscaled dataset is CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo). AEO statistics are CC BY 4.0.
citation: Algeria Earth Observatory (2026). Algeria terrestrial water storage anomaly (downscaled GRACE/GRACE-FO), version 1.0.0. — from Li, F. (2025), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17265162, and Li & Kusche (2026), GRL, doi:10.1029/2025GL119881.

references.citation: Li, F. & Kusche, J. (2026). Reproducing GRACE Total Water Storage Change at Finer Spatial Scales. Geophysical Research Letters 53, e2025GL119881.
Li, F. (2025). Global high-resolution (0.25°) total water storage anomaly dataset derived by reproducing GRACE data, v2. Zenodo.

spatial_extent.description: Algeria and its 69 wilayas (AEO boundaries 2026-11-20); communes not published. Tipaza has no value (coastal cells are ocean in the source).

temporal_extent.description: 2002-04 to 2025-03 with 33 missing months, including the 2017–2018 gap between missions.

resolution.spatial: Wilayas (0.25° cells; GRACE resolves about 300 km)

variables.name: tws_anomaly_cm
variables.description: Water storage anomaly vs the unit's 2004–2009 mean

variables.name: uncertainty_cm
variables.description: Unit mean of the downscaling uncertainty

processing: Area-weighted means of the 0.25° cells; re-referenced to 2004–2009; Theil–Sen trend and Mann–Kendall test on the deseasonalised series.
validation: Downloaded file checked against the Zenodo MD5; national trend −0.25 cm/yr (95 % −0.26 to −0.23), Mann–Kendall p < 0.0001.
limitations: GRACE resolves about 300 km: only 9 wilayas are at least one mascon in area; values of the others are mostly model detail.
algeria_notes: Storage declines over most of the country; the strongest declines are in the north-east (about −1.2 cm/year), where the value rests largely on the downscaling.
